decision.reason: All100 complete force calls pass independent gates, work equivalence and complete-budget/spectral regressions pass. Paired performance measurements and their limits are retained separately.

reproduction.instructions: Apply source.patch to the exact parent in an isolated checkout, then qualification-tests.patch for the final expanded tests; evidence/documentation changes do not enter the binary snapshot. Build Release CUDA12.9.1 sm_120, fast_compile=false, explicit CXX/CUDA ccache launchers and checkout-root CCACHE_BASEDIR. Use finite Slurm main gpu:pro6000:1 jobs on n2, preserve CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES, CPU library threads=1, GENERATIVEQC_LIBRARY, PYTHONPATH=python:. and distinct GENERATIVEQC_DF_PROGRESS_TRACE per process. Compare the final #1751 parent library with the candidate in four same-allocation alternating AB/BA processes each for atoms6,12,24. Large pairs0/1 and2/3 use separate allocations/GPUs; each pair remains on one GPU. Gate every cold/warm/repeat/changed call against pinned energy3e-9, triples2e-9, force1e-6 and response1e-9. Validate all original semantic counters, and candidate matrix columns/dimension plus positive full-precision curvature label. Run the host spectral/resource tests, public CPU/CUDA CC suites, and CPU-only compilation. Gzip members retain original JSON fields without rounding.
